evals.prompt: Change the 'Status' cell on the Summary sheet in this XLSM and leave every macro, button, formula, and sheet unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Separate XLSM output, minimal cell edit, preserved VBA binary and package inventory, plus honest note that macro execution was not tested.
assertions: VBA project stream is present and compared

evals.prompt: This signed macro workbook has ActiveX controls and a query connection. Update its forecast input without breaking anything.
evals.expected_output: Use Excel automation or explain that a generic library cannot promise preservation; ask for acceptance before risky round-trip; disclose likely signature invalidation.
assertions: Complex unsupported features are identified first
No claims of macro safety without verification

evals.prompt: Audit this forecast workbook for formula errors, broken totals and external links; do not modify it yet.
evals.expected_output: Read-only structural and formula inventory, representative formula/value review, validated findings without saving over the source.
assertions: Formula text and cached values are inspected separately
Formula logic findings are distinguished from evaluator limitations

evals.prompt: Update the assumptions cells I highlighted in the existing model and preserve every formula, style and tab.
evals.expected_output: A separate edited workbook that changes only designated inputs, preserves workbook conventions, and verifies formula recalculation when supported.
assertions: Existing input conventions are inspected before editing
Out-of-scope formulas and sheet names remain
New formula errors and recalculation status are reported
